title: Halloween Challenge - Pumpkin Patch Smash
author: Active_Cauliflower71
selftext:
Hello everyone, MOBICAT here.

I have released PUMPKIN PATCH SMASH on [itch.io](http://itch.io)

 [https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash](https://mobicat.itch.io/pumpkin-patch-smash)

It has thousands of fully destructible pumpkins set in a survival action game.

The ultimate goal is to smash all the pumpkins at the patch. Earn your place on the leaderboard with the fastest completion. But it isn't as easy as you think. The pumpkins fight back at night and progressively get more difficult. The patch also has 2 bosses that trigger throughout the game. 

Spoilers on the entire game:

Core game loop:  
\- **Smash as many pumpkins as you can during the day.**  You can find more efficient ways of killing pumpkins like unlocking the herbicide, kei truck, tractor, bomb pumpkins, hit giant hay barrels to crush them and more.  
\- **Fight enemy pumpkins at night.** There are 3 core enemy types. The caster (firebolt), charger, and  ground smasher. Waves of pumpkins pile up if you don't kill them quick enough. Stepping on pumpkins will wake new enemies up (watch your step).  
\- **Defeat the bosses.** There are 2 scripted encounters which require their own strategy. 

\-**Compete for the best time.** The game is hooked up to a leaderboard so whoever can beat the game fastest earns their place on the leaderboard securing the diamond(1st), emerald(2nd), or ruby pumpkin (3rd) 

FAQ:   
1) **Can you put this game on roblox?** You do it.

2) **I'm going to put this game on roblox, you mad?** No. go for it.

3) **Is this slop?** I'd say mostly not at this point. Maybe a 70-30 mix
